item.text:
The module calculates order totals, applies `SAVE10`/`SAVE20` discounts, computes an average, and formats a receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, causing a crash. Use `i < items.length`.
- Consequently, `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` also crash for any order.
- `averageItemPrice` divides a quantity-weighted total by the number of line items. If it means average per unit, divide by total quantity instead; empty input also needs handling.
- Invalid codes such as `"toString"` can produce `NaN` because inherited properties of `discounts` are accepted. Check own properties only.
